name: player_update_master_type_basic
description: Player::UpdateMasterTypeBasic updates the basic-mode motion basis and steer basis, applies local velocity to world-space X/Z movement, resolves modal probe height, updates the root Object3D transform, computes FX world offset, copies the root matrix, and caches bank and rotation state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this top-level movement helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player master-type movement/source-cluster pass.
